about_the_game:
Card battles meet mercenary collection — a distilled blend of roguelite strategy.

Gold and Graves is a unique 2D roguelite deckbuilder where you fight using cards and bribe enemies to join your side mid-battle.

Combat is turn-based and position-driven, inspired by chess and SRPGs.
A wide variety of cards, relics, and events demand fresh strategies with every run.

To defeat the powerful bosses waiting in the depths of the dungeon,
you must build your own tactics, assemble mercenaries, and craft a winning deck.
Choose to escape mid-run and carry forward your rewards — even failure can make you stronger.

Conquest, collection, farming, and strategy — it's all in your hands.

Position-Based Tactical Combat

This isn’t just another turn-based system.
Cards, positioning, turn order — every decision is a variable.
A single misstep can lead to your team’s annihilation.

Within unpredictable interactions,
you must impose order with strategy and foresight.
Only true tacticians will conquer this dungeon.

Mercenary Recruitment System

Offer gold to your enemies in the heat of battle,
and they will fight for you.

Recruited mercenaries join future battles,
fighting under your command — and sometimes, at your sacrifice.

Who lives, who is left behind — it's your call.
Buy loyalty with gold, and use cold calculation to push through the dungeon.

Recruit enemy creatures to build your own army. Collect, manage, and deploy them strategically.

Farming and Escape – Failure Isn’t the End

This isn't your average roguelike.
One defeat doesn’t mean starting from zero.

By choosing to escape mid-run,
you can carry over select cards, relics, and mercenaries into your next attempt.

Repeat farming and preparation to grow stronger.
Better decks, stronger synergies, deeper strategy —

Endless Combinations, Infinite Replayability

Each run brings a completely different strategy,
with new combinations of cards, relics, and monsters.

Failure is learning. Find your own answers to the puzzle,
and refine your deck with each run.
Every playthrough is a new challenge.
victory is built through iteration.
